```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(here)

# Everything comes from the tables built by ingest/make_ppd_tables.R.
programs <- readRDS(here("data", "ppd_programs.rds"))
yearly   <- readRDS(here("data", "ppd_yearly.rds"))

# One institution, chosen by the unitid parameter at the top of this file.
inst <- programs %>% filter(unitid == params$unitid)
if (nrow(inst) == 0) stop("No programs found for unitid ", params$unitid,
                          ". Look yours up in data/institutions.csv.")
inst_name <- inst$instnm[1]
inst_opeid <- inst$opeid6[1]

# Programs that exist now (enrolled Title IV students in 2023-24 or 2024-25).
current <- inst %>% filter(exists_in_2024_or_2025 == 1)
tested  <- current %>% filter(earnings_test != "Not tested")

fmt_dollar <- label_dollar(accuracy = 1)
fmt_n      <- label_comma(accuracy = 1)
```

# `r inst_name`

::: {.callout-note title="About the data"}
This report reads the **2026 Program Performance Data (PPD:2026)**, published by
the U.S. Department of Education in December 2025 for the AHEAD negotiated
rulemaking and updated January 8, 2026. The Department describes it as a
preview, for information only. The official results under the Student Tuition
and Transparency System (STATS) are expected in **February 2027**, at the
6-digit CIP level. A program here is one combination of institution, credential
level, and 4-digit CIP. Earnings are for Title IV completers working and not
enrolled four years after the 2017-18 and 2018-19 cohorts, in 2024 dollars.
Debt is in 2019 dollars. Counts between 10 and 19 were set to 15 by the
Department, and smaller counts are suppressed.
:::

## At a glance

```{r}
#| label: glance
tibble(
  What = c("Programs with Title IV students, 2023-24 or 2024-25",
           "Title IV enrollment, 2024-25",
           "Programs with a reportable earnings result",
           "Programs that pass the earnings test",
           "Programs that fail the earnings test"),
  Count = c(nrow(current),
            sum(current$t4enrl_prg_2025, na.rm = TRUE),
            nrow(tested),
            sum(tested$earnings_test == "Pass"),
            sum(tested$earnings_test == "Fail"))
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(Count, decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_options(table.width = pct(70), column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
```

## The earnings test, program by program

Each tested program's median earnings next to the benchmark it was measured
against. Programs are sorted so the ones closest to failing come first.

```{r}
#| label: test-table
tested %>%
  arrange(earnings_margin) %>%
  select(credlev, cip4_code, cip4_title, t4enrl_prg_2025,
         md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb, earnings_margin, earnings_test) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "credlev") %>%
  cols_label(cip4_code = "CIP", cip4_title = "Program",
             t4enrl_prg_2025 = "Enrolled 2024-25",
             md_earn_wne_p4 = "Median earnings",
             earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb = "Benchmark",
             earnings_margin = "Margin", earnings_test = "Result") %>%
  fmt_number(t4enrl_prg_2025, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_currency(c(md_earn_wne_p4, earn_bnchmrk_cip2_wageb, earnings_margin), decimals = 0) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = earnings_test == "Fail")) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## Margin above the benchmark

```{r}
#| label: margin-chart
#| fig-height: 6
tested %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(cip4_title, " (", credlev, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = earnings_margin, y = reorder(label, earnings_margin), fill = earnings_test)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Pass = "#0C2340", Fail = "#E87722"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Median earnings minus benchmark (2024 dollars)", y = NULL,
       title = "How far each program sits from its earnings benchmark") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
```

## Ten years of enrollment

Title IV enrollment by credential level, 2015-16 through 2024-25.

```{r}
#| label: enrollment-trend
#| fig-height: 4
yearly %>%
  filter(opeid6 == inst_opeid) %>%
  group_by(award_year, credlev) %>%
  summarise(enrolled = sum(t4enrl_prg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(award_year, enrolled, colour = credlev)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:2025, labels = function(y) paste0(y - 1, "-", substr(y, 3, 4))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Title IV students", colour = NULL,
       title = "Title IV enrollment by credential level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Debt and earnings

```{r}
#| label: debt-table
current %>%
  filter(!is.na(debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn) | !is.na(md_earn_wne_p4)) %>%
  select(credlev, cip4_title, debt_all_stgp_eval_n, debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn, md_earn_wne_p4) %>%
  arrange(credlev, desc(debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn)) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "credlev") %>%
  cols_label(cip4_title = "Program", debt_all_stgp_eval_n = "Borrowers",
             debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn = "Median debt (2019 $)", md_earn_wne_p4 = "Median earnings (2024 $)") %>%
  fmt_number(debt_all_stgp_eval_n, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_currency(c(debt_all_stgp_eval_mdn, md_earn_wne_p4), decimals = 0) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

## Every current program

This section appears only in the HTML version. A 245-row table is fine on
a web page and silly on paper, so the PDF, Word and slide versions skip it.
Delete the `:::` lines around it if you want it everywhere.

```{r}
#| label: all-programs
current %>%
  select(credlev, cip4_code, cip4_title, t4enrl_prg_2025, t4completers_2025, pell_stu_count_2025, earnings_test) %>%
  arrange(credlev, cip4_code) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "credlev") %>%
  cols_label(cip4_code = "CIP", cip4_title = "Program", t4enrl_prg_2025 = "Enrolled 2024-25",
             t4completers_2025 = "Completers 2024-25", pell_stu_count_2025 = "Pell 2024-25",
             earnings_test = "Earnings test") %>%
  fmt_number(c(t4enrl_prg_2025, t4completers_2025, pell_stu_count_2025), decimals = 0) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

:::
